The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board has released marks for TGT Hindi and TGT Natural Science posts under post codes 807/24 and 806/24. A total of 546 vacancies were announced for these posts in the Directorate of Education and NDMC. For TGT Natural Science, 830 candidates, including 435 male and 395 female candidates, were provisionally shortlisted for the e-dossier process based on their examination performance and qualifying marks. Based on their performance and minimum qualifying marks, shortlisted candidates are now invited to upload their e-dossiers for further selection. Earlier, DSSSB PTG Commerce Result 2026 has been announced by the Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board with the cut-off marks per category and details for shortlisting candidates for e-dossier submission. The PGT Commerce Result 2026 is prepared after analysing the written test held on September 22, 2025. For the Advertisement No. 10/2024, a total of 2531 candidates had applied for the position, out of which 105 candidates have been shortlisted provisionally. Candidates can check the announced cut-off marks for the male and female categories. Continue reading for more details.

DSSSB TGT Marks 2026 Released

DSSSB has released the marks for TGT Hindi posts under post code 807/24. The exams were held in 17 August and 23 August last year for 192 vacancies in the Directorate of Education and NDMC. Candidates who got the required marks have been shortlisted and can now upload their e-dossiers for the next process.

DSSSB TGT Hindi Result 2026 PDF: Click Here to Download 

DSSSB also released the marks for TGT Natural Science posts under post code 806/24. There were 354 vacancies for male and female candidates. After the exams held in 6 September and 7 September , a total of 830 candidates were shortlisted to upload their e-dossiers based on their performance.

DSSSB PGT History Result 2026 Released

DSSSB 2026 PGT Result  (Male & Female), code-wise 830/24, has been declared by the Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board. The recruitment is done for 37 vacancies through Advertisement No. 10/2024. The written test for this examination was held on 25 September 2025, where 2531 candidates appeared. Now, candidates can verify their marks online through the OARS website.

DSSSB PGT Cut Off Marks 2026 & Shortlisting for E-Dossier Upload

The marks secured by the candidates are different depending upon the category, wherein the highest cut-off marks are obtained by the UR category candidates. Shortlisting of the candidates at this stage is completely provisional and will depend on their eligibility criteria.

How to Download DSSSB Result 2026?

The DSSSB has released the DSSSB Result 2026 in PDF format which includes the roll numbers of shortlisted candidates for various posts. Candidates can download the result by following these simple steps:

  1. Visit the official website: dsssb.delhi.gov.in
  2. Click on “Results” under the Important Information section on the homepage
  3. Select “Latest Result” from the dropdown menu
  4. Find your post code and click on Download
  5. Open the PDF and search your roll number using Ctrl + F

Details mentioned on the DSSSB Result 2026

The DSSSB Result PDF includes important information related to the selected candidates and the recruitment process. Candidates should carefully check all details mentioned in the result.

  • Name of the exam conducting body
  • Post name and post code
  • Roll number of DSSSB shortlisted candidates
  • Category of the candidate
  • Result notice number and date
  • Important instructions related to further selection process

Next Steps After Declaration of DSSSB Result?

Candidates whose roll number appear in the DSSSB Tier 1 Result 2026 will be called for next stage. The next step in the selection process includes the skill test round which is conducted to check the practical abilities of candidates such as typing, stenography or other job specific skills. Candidates must meet the required standards in the skill test to move ahead in the selection process. Details like date, time and instructions for the skill test will be shared separately on the official website soon.

Message for the Candidates who have not qualified in DSSSB Exam

Candidates who could not qualify in the DSSSB exam should not feel disheartened, as the number of vacancies was limited this year and the competition was very high. Not getting selected does not mean you are not capable. Candidates can check their marks and scorecard when released and learn from their mistakes. They can work on your weak areas and improve preparation strategy. It has recommended practice with DSSSB Previous Year Papers.

DSSSB 2026 Score Card

The DSSSB Score Card 2026 has been released on the official website for ASO, Junior Assistant and PGT posts. Candidates can download the scorecard PDF to check their obtained marks. The PDF shows the marks obtained by candidates in the exam along with section wise cut off. The scorecard helps candidates understand their performance and prepare better for future exams. DSSSB 2026 Cut Off

The DSSSB Cut Off 2026 has been released along with the result on the official website. The cut off for various posts has been released separately. Candidates can check the category wise DSSSB Exam 2026 cut off from the result PDF. Those who obtained marks above or equal to cut off marks are provisionally shortlisted to appear in Skill Test round.

DSSSB Result 2026 FAQs

Q. When is the DSSSB Result 2026 released?

Ans: The DSSSB Result 2026 is released on 27th March 2026 on the official website.

Q. Where can candidates check the DSSSB Result 2026?

Ans: Candidates can check and download the DSSSB Result 2026 from the official website at dsssb.delhi.gov.in.

Q. What details are mentioned in the DSSSB Result PDF?

Ans: The result PDF includes roll numbers of selected candidates, post name, category, cut off marks and important instructions for the next selection stage.

Q. What happens after the DSSSB Tier 1 exam?

Ans: Candidates who qualify will be called for the next stage i.e. skill test.

Q. Is the DSSSB Cut Off 2026 released?

Ans: Yes, the DSSSB Cut Off 2026 has been released along with the result.
